Each team is seeded on its aggregate: the sum of its four runners’ Personal records in the 1600 Meters, each their fastest outdoor mark in any season, set on or before November 6, 2026. Indoor marks, relay splits, exhibition and hand-timed marks never count. Where a runner’s mile converted to the 1600 Meters at even pace (mile time × 1600 / 1609.344) is faster than their 1600 Meters, the converted mark stands in and is marked as estimated; a team with one is marked as including estimated legs. Set is the season a mark was run in.

A team missing a runner, or with a runner who has no mark in the 1600 Meters, has no aggregate and is listed last. Runners are in leg order; names link to their profiles.
